About Me

The Story Behind the Counsel

I am a BA LLB student at United University, Prayagraj, with hands-on legal internship experience and a strong interest in legal research, drafting, court procedures, and legal writing.

My academic journey has been shaped by internships at prestigious institutions — Ara Bar Association, AGISS Research Institute, and Record Of Law — alongside a published article on Times Law and participation in moot court competitions.

" Law is not merely a profession — it is a responsibility to uphold justice and protect the dignity of every individual. "

My goal is to build a meaningful career in law while continuously contributing to society through advocacy, research, and writing. I believe in the power of legal knowledge as a tool for social change.
